source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Use a unit-square or rectangle area model to connect multiplication of fractions with shaded area or rectangle area.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Rectangle area is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Use a unit-square or rectangle area model to connect multiplication of' is answered as rectangle area rather than unit square.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: unit square still holds here even though Use the unit square as the whole when representing fraction products visually is missing from the stem — on the item about Use a unit-square or rectangle area model to connect.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: The unit square rule also covers this: perimeter of fractional rectangles, so it is not an exception — on the item about Use a unit-square or rectangle area model to connect.

intelligence.enrichment: The area of a rectangle with fractional side lengths equals the product of its side lengths; a fraction product can be represented as the area selected in a unit square.
